Renovated 3 bedroom apartment with patio | Rua Guerra Junqueiro, Coimbra

The highlight of this property is the private patio, a versatile outdoor space, ideal for outdoor dining, family moments, leisure or even creating a pleasant green area.

Excellent sun exposure and natural light;

Contemporary finishes;
